purpose: G20+ coverage expansion blueprint — a candidate intake list only. Nothing in this file is public content. No candidate listed here may be rendered into /rules/, /briefs/, Passage Check, the Static Agent Interface (/api/v1/), or the sitemap until it independently passes the existing six-gate publication pipeline and its data/rules/<slug>.json page_status is set to published through that pipeline, not through this file.
not_a_publication_channel_notice: This file cannot publish a country. It records research/priority metadata only. Promotion to published happens exclusively via the existing data/rules/<slug>.json six-gate pipeline (see governance.html), never by editing this file.
candidate_status_model_notes: Every entry in this P8-0 blueprint is recorded as candidate_only, regardless of how much prior internal research exists (see existing_internal_data_file), because no candidate has yet been re-reviewed under this coverage-intake process. Advancing a status is a future, separate, reviewed action — never a bulk edit of this file.
existing_published_jurisdictions_note: These 8 jurisdictions are unaffected by this blueprint. Their data/rules/<slug>.json page_status and public surfaces are not touched by P8-0.
no_inference_rule: No rule, threshold, or regulatory posture may ever be inferred for a candidate from its currency code, region, G20 membership, EU/AU membership, or a neighboring country's published rules. Every fact requires its own primary official source before it may be published.

candidates.expected_difficulty: High. No internal research file exists yet — from-scratch intake.
